$comment: Hand-edited source of truth for the Dovetail clone IA. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this file by build.mjs. Route membership was derived by running react-router matchRoutes over the real route config (src/routes.jsx and src/pages/*/routes.jsx, including the data globs and slug arrays) against src/data/routes.txt plus /menu/. Section order was checked against the running clone at http://localhost:5210. In implementedBy, paths are under src/ and " | " separates duplicate implementations of one original block.

meta.title: Dovetail clone: information architecture
meta.source: Dovetail clone (/Users/riyaghosh/V3/dovetail): src/routes.jsx, src/pages/**, src/components/**, src/chrome.jsx, src/data/routes.txt, CLONE_SPEC.md, specs/*.md

categories.CHROME: Site chrome: the banner, navbars and footers, whether App.jsx renders them or a campaign page renders its own inside <main>.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that holds the H1.
categories.PROOF: Customer evidence: logo strips, testimonials, story cards and carousels, ratings and analyst (Forrester TEI) cards.
categories.FEATURE: Product and capability explanation: feature rows, tabbed or sticky showcases, integration and security grids.
categories.CONTENT: Long-form reading and editorial blocks: article titles and bodies, rich text, story and event bodies, prose.
categories.LISTING: Indexes and collections: card grids, row lists, filter pills, A-Z lists and directory groupings.
categories.CONVERSION: Offers and forms: pricing plans, trial offers, sign-up and download forms, quiz promos.
categories.CTA: Closing call-to-action bands that end a page.
categories.TOOL: Interactive, stateful tools: the ROI calculator and the role quizzes.
categories.CAMPAIGN: Blocks of the blue standalone campaign pages (/the-best-never-guess/ and the AWS Summit page).
categories.LAUNCH: Blocks unique to the Launch microsite (/launch/suns-out/).
categories.DECOR: Decorative transitions with no content of their own.
categories.OVERLAY: Fixed or modal UI that is not part of the page flow (timed promos, mobile drawers).

chrome.banner.description: One-line announcement strip above the nav ("Ask. Never guess. Introducing Digital Twins →"). Not sticky. Palette follows the page: default dark, light veil on light pages, `accent` tint over the product/story colour, `legal` palette on legal pages.
chrome.banner.scope: 1896 routes across home, product page, pricing, enterprise, enterprise article, deploy, solution page, role page, role quiz, menu, blog index, blog post, changelog index, changelog entry, guide article, guide hub, guides index, contributors index, contributor profile, demo form, comparison page, quiz hub, roi calculator, template landing, tools article, legal index, legal document, not found, customers index, customer story, events / webinars index, event detail, live demos, resource centre, resources guide, industry report, careers, podcast. Hidden on the launch and campaign pages and on the Digital Twins product page (alert bar off in its data file).

chrome.navbar.description: Main site navigation: logo, Product/Platform/Resources dropdowns, Log in and Book a demo, and the ≤1185px "Menu" pill that links to /menu/. Relative, not sticky. Variants via chrome: light ink, solid `navBg` colour (product accent, story blue), `navButtons:false` on legal docs.
chrome.navbar.scope: 1896 routes across home, product page, pricing, enterprise, enterprise article, deploy, solution page, role page, role quiz, launch microsite, blog index, blog post, changelog index, changelog entry, guide article, guide hub, guides index, contributors index, contributor profile, demo form, comparison page, quiz hub, roi calculator, template landing, tools article, legal index, legal document, not found, customers index, customer story, events / webinars index, event detail, live demos, resource centre, resources guide, industry report, careers, podcast. Not rendered on the menu route or the two blue campaign pages, which draw their own header.
